indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: State population represented in the wave's religion table.
indicators.method: Printed state total: Table 10.1 (2005, all ages) or Table 42 state column (2015/2020, 18+).
indicators.quality_notes: The 2005 universe is all persons; the 2015 and 2020 universe is persons 18 and over. The level difference across 2005 and the later waves is a universe break, not change.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the state population with a stated religious affiliation.
indicators.method: 2005: 100 * (Total - None or refused) / Total. 2015/2020: 100 by construction, no-religion folded into Other.
indicators.quality_notes: For 2015 and 2020 this metric is flat at 100 percent by construction and does not distinguish states.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share in the 2005 None or refused category; null for 2015 and 2020.
indicators.method: 2005: 100 * None or refused / Total. 2015/2020: null (no separable no-religion category).
indicators.quality_notes: The 2005 None or refused category mixes persons with no religion and refusals to answer. The 2005 monograph prose claim of 'about 1 in 6' with no religion is refuted by its own table (222 of 19,907, near 1.1 percent); the table governs.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.notes: Census affiliation, not practice or membership. Flat at 100 percent for 2015 and 2020 by construction.

visual_layers.label: No religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: Palau 2005 None or refused share by state.
visual_layers.notes: 2005 only; the category is None or refused and mixes no-religion with non-response.
